findings.reason: src/index.ts:97 re-exports getScalarValue, and the diff changes parser_scalar.ts:284 from (state: ParserState) to (input: string). CHANGELOG.md, which follows Keep a Changelog and SemVer, has no Unreleased section and goes straight to 4.2.0. The signature change itself is what the locked test needs: spec.test.mjs:166 already passes a string, and the diff leaves that test untouched. So the gap is only the missing note about a breaking change to the public API, and the severity stays low.
findings.claim: getScalarValue is publicly exported, and the change alters its first parameter from ParserState to string without a CHANGELOG entry, so external callers may break on upgrade.
findings.evidence: src/index.ts:97 re-exports the function: `export { getScalarValue } from './parser/parser_scalar.ts'`. The diff changes its first parameter from `state: ParserState` (it used to read `const { input } = state`) to `input: string`. CHANGELOG.md has no Unreleased section that mentions this. The code I read doesn't show whether 4.2.0 shipped this export. All in-repo callers were updated: from_events.ts:105, constructor.ts:152 and test/spec/spec.test.mjs:166.
